subject.title: [Bug]: delivery-recovery 0 recovered / N failed after gateway restart — recovery starts before channel transport ready

question: For Feishu outbound restart recovery, should the next fix use a Feishu-owned reconnect drain on WebSocket ready/reconnected, a gateway-wide readiness gate before startup recovery, or a retry-accounting policy change across restarts?
rationale: Source shows the generic retry-budget bug is fixed, but choosing between transport readiness, plugin reconnect drain, and retry reset changes recovery semantics and could affect duplicate-send versus message-loss behavior.

options.title: Feishu reconnect drain
options.body: Add a Feishu plugin-owned drainPendingDeliveries call when the WebSocket reports ready/reconnected, with selection scoped to Feishu account and live restart proof.

options.title: Gateway readiness gate
options.body: Delay startup outbound recovery until channel readiness is reported, which may help more channels but broadens the startup lifecycle contract.

options.title: Retry policy change
options.body: Reset or cap retryCount across restarts only if maintainers explicitly decide restart failures should not count like delivery attempts.

recommendation.title: Feishu reconnect drain
recommendation.body: Add a Feishu plugin-owned drainPendingDeliveries call when the WebSocket reports ready/reconnected, with selection scoped to Feishu account and live restart proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining behavior is Feishu-specific and the package metadata names this handle as the Feishu/Lark community maintainer signal.
